correctness.rationale: Exact seven-state CTMC first-step matrix inversion yields the stated polynomial ratio with strictly positive denominator on the entire domain. Descartes sign changes plus exact ordered rational brackets for all eight coefficient roots prove the unique switch; the exact two-state-patch comparison establishes sharp minimality. The bundled verifier rebuilds and checks all identities; 35 rational examples are only corroboration. Boundary c=0 is used by continuity and all claimed strict inequalities are for c>0.

value.rationale: The optimal patch-protection priority in finite stochastic metapopulations is an ecologically motivated resource-allocation objective. A complete two-parameter classification with the sharp hazard-ratio six and a uniquely switching colonization threshold identifies a non-obvious positional-versus-quality tradeoff; three patches are the smallest network in which it can occur. The result is general throughout its natural restricted model family and does not rely on arbitrarily sampled cases or claim empirical efficacy.
